requirements.subject: federation
requirements.statement: Document the federation's HLA exchanged data, agreement and minimum exchange conditions in an OMT FOM using one or more FOM modules and one MIM.
requirements.conditions: The standard does not prescribe the simulation data selection. The arbitrary federation's exchange agreement and model documentation belong to its users/developers, not to the RTI-only claim.
open_items: RTI admission and MIM composition remain applicable in the separate FDD/OMT inventory; this exclusion is not an exemption for malformed structural input.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Maintain simulation-associated object representation and attribute values in the joined federates.
requirements.conditions: RTI routing/checkpoint retention is not simulation-model maintenance.
open_items: Application memory and simulation semantics require identified federates, outside this RTI-only assessment.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Use simulation attribute/interaction data to provide infrastructure services without changing their simulation content.
requirements.conditions: The RTI may retain/use data for services such as declaration management; federate-associated simulation attributes are not RTI-owned.

tests.name: twoSessionsNegotiateCancelAndConfirmTransferWithEvokedCallbacks
tests.oracle: The registering owner and discovering peer report true/false ownership; negotiated confirmation transfers it, the former owner's update throws AttributeNotOwned, and the peer's bytes and producing-federate identity are reflected.

open_items: The linked byte-preservation transfer example is not an exhaustive payload-immutability oracle over all transports, timestamped queues, restore and MOM adjustments.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Keep simulation ownership distinct from the permitted RTI ownership of federation MOM instance attributes.
requirements.conditions: MOM ownership is an explicit exception, not permission for RTI ownership of arbitrary simulation attributes.

tests.name: predefinedMomAttributeIsReportedAsRtiOwnedAndCannotBeAcquired
tests.oracle: A predefined MOM attribute reports RTI-owned rather than federate-owned; both acquisition modes report unavailable, no acquisition callback occurs, and RTI ownership persists.

open_items: Identify all RTI-owned predefined versus user-extension MOM attributes; one attribute is not a whole-MIM disposition oracle.

requirements.subject: federation
requirements.statement: Exchange FOM data between joined federates only through RTI services.
requirements.conditions: Applies during a federation execution, not to unrelated application communication.
open_items: A functioning RTI cannot prove that arbitrary federates never exchange FOM data over a side channel.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Declare the data a joined federate provides and requires and supply its changing attribute/interaction data to the RTI.
open_items: Application declaration completeness is separate from RTI interpretation of admitted publications/subscriptions.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Deliver shared data consistently with recipients' declared data, transport-reliability and ordering requirements.
requirements.conditions: FOM and active declarations govern delivery; requirements apply across the execution, not merely initial join.

tests.name: regionsRouteByAttributePairsAndCommittedBoundsAcrossThreeSessions
tests.oracle: Three Java sessions assert exact delivered attribute sets and positive/negative interaction recipients for near/far regions, then changed recipients after commit; invalid later association does not partially change routing.

open_items: The regional recipient assertions do not independently prove reliability, timestamp ordering, all subscription changes or every transport. Detailed obligations belong to the interface slices.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Provide coordination, synchronization and data exchange so participants' coordination needs are handled consistently over the execution.
requirements.conditions: Infrastructure consistency is separate from the scientific correctness of participants' use of received data.

tests.name: test_tc002_federation_synchronized_fires_once
tests.oracle: Two real Python federates receive announcements; one achievement does not synchronize, both achievements produce exactly one synchronized callback at each. Bounded synchronization facet, not arbitrary-model correctness or all Clause 5.3 coordination.

tests.name: test_tc005_update_reflect_round_trip_bytes
tests.oracle: Real publisher/subscriber exchange attribute bytes and assert the reflected payload at the discovered instance. Receive-order data-exchange facet only; not all temporal coordination or scientific correctness.

open_items: Synchronization and attribute exchange are linked to live bounded cases; temporal coordination, every execution state and arbitrary federation use remain open. Clause 5.3 is not fully decomposed or verified.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Provide substantively correct data at appropriate times and use received data correctly.
requirements.conditions: These are joined-federate responsibilities under the federation agreement, not an RTI assertion about arbitrary simulation models.
open_items: Do not infer application correctness from successful routing or a passing RTI scenario.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Use the HLA interface specification to interact with the RTI during execution.
requirements.conditions: The interface specifies interaction with infrastructure, not particular application data. Standard Java is the selected binding; Go/Python are product interfaces.

tests.name: twoSessionsNegotiateCancelAndConfirmTransferWithEvokedCallbacks
tests.oracle: The registering owner and discovering peer report true/false ownership; negotiated confirmation transfers it, the former owner's update throws AttributeNotOwned, and the peer's bytes and producing-federate identity are reflected.

open_items: The Java case demonstrates a supported interface path, not compliance by every arbitrary federate or full interface coverage.

requirements.subject: rti
requirements.statement: Enforce at most one joined-federate owner per instance attribute while allowing dynamic acquisition and divestiture.
requirements.conditions: Different attributes of one object can have different owners; zero joined-federate owners is allowed.

tests.name: twoSessionsNegotiateCancelAndConfirmTransferWithEvokedCallbacks
tests.oracle: The registering owner and discovering peer report true/false ownership; negotiated confirmation transfers it, the former owner's update throws AttributeNotOwned, and the peer's bytes and producing-federate identity are reflected.

tests.name: TestIEEE2010UnconditionalProgressesSeparatePendingRequests
tests.oracle: Queued single-attribute requests transfer first to federate 2, preserve federate 3's waiters, leave the unwaited attribute unowned and then transfer wanted attributes to federate 3.

open_items: Sequential owner checks are not a universal concurrent invariant over transfer, deletion, resignation and restore. The underlying federation rule has an applicable RTI enforcement surface.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Document publicly available object classes, attributes and interactions in an OMT SOM.
requirements.conditions: Use one or more SOM modules and an optional MIM; the developer chooses the particular data.
open_items: No arbitrary SOM authoring or completeness claim; RTI model consumption is not SOM documentation.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Support the updates/reflections and interaction sending/receiving capabilities documented in the SOM.
requirements.conditions: Export internally computed updated values and exercise externally represented interactions when those capabilities are declared.
open_items: RTI routing tests do not prove each identified federate implements its declared capabilities.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Support and document dynamic transfer/acceptance for SOM-declared ownable or reflectable instance attributes.
requirements.conditions: The capability claim is conditional on the particular SOM, not a requirement that every federate acquire every attribute.
open_items: RTI transfer support is assessed separately in ownership-ddm.json; no arbitrary federate capability verdict.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Vary and document the conditions under which owned attributes are updated as specified in the SOM.
requirements.conditions: Rates and change thresholds are examples; federation-specific application update policy belongs to the federate.
open_items: Retaining updateCondition text or RTI update-rate metadata does not execute a federate's simulation threshold policy.

requirements.subject: federate
requirements.statement: Manage local time to coordinate exchange and adhere to the federation's chosen time-management approach.
requirements.conditions: The approach is selected by federation designers.
open_items: RTI logical-time factories and service tests are different obligations; arbitrary application policy compliance is outside scope.
